text:
maya: Quick note from onboarding: sampleapp using node batching helper hit a dims mismatch and a silent empty-vector case. Wanted to surface before more users hit it.

trent: can you paste the minimal call and what you saw?

maya: minimal: client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/rerank-1', input: ['x','y'], retry: { max_attempts: 2 } })
Observed: sometimes embeddings arrays were empty ([]) and sometimes vectors were length 512 instead of expected 768. Headers (when present) had x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-compact and x-retry-count: 1.

lee: sounds like two separate issues: (1) fallback variant returned on retry (compact=512d), (2) an upstream transient returned an empty body and node helper accepted it as valid rather than surfacing an error.

sam: SDK parity note: python helper raises on empty body; node helper normalizes to [] currently. Also node had a default fallback_model set in batching helper config which python didn't. That explains why only node sampleapp showed this.

maya: any quick workarounds?

lee: for now set retry: { fallback_model: null } or explicitly retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' } to avoid compact fallback. Also add a preflight check in sampleapp: if (!response.embeddings || response.embeddings.length === 0) throw; and assert response.embeddings[0].length === expectedDim before downstream use.

trent: opened DEVEX-4342 to remove implicit node fallback, surface response.model_variant from headers, and make helper error on empty bodies. ops-bot queued a patch job.

ops-bot: Created DEVEX-4342 and triggered deploy/patch/5843 to staging 914 (2478306000).

maya: confirmed local fix with explicit fallback_model: null restores 768 dims and surfaces empty-body error. I'll add a small onboarding checklist item: "validate embedding length and fail loudly on empty vectors". Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
